title: Reducing the Duration of Untreated Psychosis in the United States
brief_summary: The goal of this project is to investigate whether a systematic screening approach for individuals with first episode psychosis (FEP) can substantially reduce Duration of Untreated Psychosis (DUP). The study team will evaluate the feasibility of screening a consecutive help-seeking population entering mental health services in order to facilitate early identification of FEP cases, rapid referral to specialty care and engagement in treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age 12- 30
* ability to participate in assessments in English
* ability to provide informed consent (assent for those under age 18)
* meet criteria for psychosis or psychosis risk on SIPS

Exclusion Criteria:

* previous diagnosis of schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder.
study_population: Individuals ages 12 to 30 entering child/adolescent and adult community mental health clinics.
